name: Finite Element Method
description: Philosophy of finite element analysis; direct stiffness method; potential energy approach; Galerkin method; formulation for bar and truss; formulation for beam and frame; plane stress and plane strain problems; CST, LST, and isoparametric formulation; quadrilateral elements; 3D finite element analysis; plate and shell element formulation; treatment of constraints; transient problems.
